data.title: Level 2 Assignment Agentic Workflow Development - February
data.description: This assignment is your opportunity to apply everything from Level 2 by designing and delivering a real, working agentic workflow that automates one meaningful task from your day-to-day work.

json_data.content: This assignment is your opportunity to apply everything from Level 2 by designing and delivering a real, working agentic workflow that automates one meaningful task from your day-to-day work. The goal is for you to experience end-to-end automation design: identifying a valuable use case, building an agent with advanced logic, and clearly articulating the business impact your solution creates.

Throughout Level 2, your questions will be answered in the sessions, labs, and demos. You are strongly encouraged to use **Copilot** to summarize lessons, clarify concepts, or troubleshoot issues as you work. Independent problem-solving is a core L2 skill — we encourage you to develop an "AI Maximalist" mindset and experiment, iterate, and explore before seeking support. Any updates will be provided during AI Academy sessions and in the Assignments Teams Channel.
Deadline
**Monday, March 2, 2026 at 11:59 PM (MT)**
Late submissions are not accepted unless extenuating circumstances are communicated prior to the deadline.
Objective
Build an agentic workflow that automates one real task from your day-to-day work using Agent Builder Console (ABC), n8n, or M365 Copilot Studio.
The Deliverables
If using ABC or n8n, you must submit three files:
**1. The Workflow File (.json)**
• What it is: This is your actual workflow
• Supported Tools: n8n and ABC
• Requirement: Your workflow must demonstrate advanced logic, robust error handling, and clear system prompting.
**2. The Submission Details File (.json)**
• What it is: This file provides details like your name and your agentic workflow
• Requirement: A structured json file that explains details and why this workflow matters.
• How to create it: Review the field definitions below, copy the template, fill in your data, and save it as a json file.
If using M365 Copilot Studio, only submit one file:
**1. The Submission Details File (.json)**
• Requirement: A structured metadata file that explains why this workflow matters.
• How to create it: Review the Field Definitions below, copy the Template, fill in your data, and save it.
Step-by-Step Instructions
**ABC or n8n**
**Step 1: Export your workflow**
Export your completed workflow from either n8n or ABC as a JSON file.
**Step 2: Create your submission details JSON**
You must create a second JSON file that describes the business value of your automation.
1. Copy the template: Copy the code block in Part A into a text editor (Notepad, VS Code).
2. Fill in the data: Enter the date.
3. Important: If you used Copilot Studio, you must include the direct link to the workflow in the workflow_deployment_url field.
**Step 3: Rename Your Files (CRITICAL)**
You must use the following naming convention, so we can correctly pair your workflow file with your submission details file:
• **Technical File**: Firstname_Lastname_WorkflowName.json
• **Business File**: Firstname_Lastname_SubmissionDetails.json
Example:
• Jane_Doe_InvoiceProcessor.json
• Jane_Doe_SubmissionDetails.json
**Step 4: Upload Assignment to AI Academy Platform**
Upload your json files:
1. Go to the AI Academy platform
2. Select the Cohort tab
3. Select December 8 - 19 Cohort
4. Click the “Assignments” tab. If you don't see the Assignments tab, please force refresh *(Ctrl + Shift + R or Shift + F5) or log out of the platform and log back in again.
5. Upload both JSON files there
Submission Description JSON
Part A provides the submission description template. Part B describe how to fill out the submission description template.
**Part A: Template (Copy & Paste) **
Copy the code block below into a text editor, fill it out, and save it as .json.

"workflow_name": "ENTER_YOUR_WORKFLOW_NAME_HERE",
"your_name": "Firstname Lastname",
"department": "COPY_ONE_NAME_FROM_THE_LIST_BELOW",
